'''Transport 651''',<ref name="Spark" /> also known as '''Freighter 651''',<ref name="BMF 34">{{BuildFalconCite|34|Starship Fact File}}</ref> was an [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]]. In [[5 BBY]], it was used by [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] as part of a trap for [[Spectres|a group of rebels]]. The rebel team heard about the transport from the criminal [[Cikatro Vizago]], who said it was carrying [[Wookiee]] [[Slavery|slaves]]. Kallus rerouted the real transport, and the rebel starship docked with Transport 651 using the false ID of [[Ghost|''Starbird'']]. Once docked, the crew went to [[Mission to free Wookiee prisoners|free]] the Wookiees, but faced a [[squad]] of [[stormtrooper]]s. While part of the team escaped, another placed explosives. To spring the trap, Kallus brought in an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] and was greeted by the [[Unidentified Imperial transport captain|ship's captain]]. The agent then brought the freighter and the rebel starship into the ISD's main [[hangar]], but the rebels undocked, and the explosives went off, destroying Transport 651.<ref name="Spark" />
